title: Quality items!
text: I'm not sure why people are complaining about the 1st box. You have a 30$ movie moment pop. It features Boba Fett carrying Han Solo in Carbonite to get his bounty.  It is one of my favorite. The Chewy mini sells for around 10$ and the star wars key chain 5$. That's 45$ worth of content for 30$ which isn't bad. I would have easily paid the 30$ for the movie moment piece. I guess most people want the smaller 10$ pop with 4 other items. I prefer quality over quantity, but to each their own. I do miss not getting the patch and pin, but that stopped before amazon took over.
label: positive
